description: Implement all applicant-facing pages: Home (list+search+filter), OpportunityDetails (detail + inline ApplyForm), ApplySuccess (confirmation + copy link), ViewApplication (view saved application), FindApplication (lookup form), NotFound (404). Also complete AppRoutes.jsx with correct paths and missing FindApplication route. Depends on FEAT-001 (shared components and API functions must exist first).
steps: Step 1 — Create src/pages/FindApplication/index.jsx (new directory + file): MUI Container, Typography heading 'Find My Application', TextField for applicationId, Button 'Find'. On submit navigate to /applications/${id}. Also add FindApplication.module.css with minimal styles.

Step 2 — Overwrite src/pages/Home/Home.jsx: useState for search and domain. Use useEffect + getOpportunities(search, domain) to fetch. Track loading/error/opportunities state. Render Navbar at top, Container with Stack for SearchBar + DomainFilter side by side, MUI Grid2 of OpportunityCards. Show Loader while loading, ErrorMessage on error, EmptyState when no results. Render Footer at bottom.
Step 3 — Overwrite src/pages/Home/Home.module.css: grid gap, filter bar layout styles.

Step 4 — Overwrite src/pages/OpportunityDetails/OpportunityDetails.jsx: useParams for id. Fetch getOpportunityById(id) on mount. Show Loader/error states. Display title (h4), companyName, type Chip, domain, location, experience, description (pre-wrap). 'Open Application Link' Button (href=applicationLink, target=_blank, rel=noopener). Divider then 'Apply Now' heading and <ApplyForm opportunityId={opportunity._id} />. Render Navbar + Footer around content.
Step 5 — Overwrite src/pages/OpportunityDetails/OpportunityDetails.module.css: field layout, section spacing.

Step 6 — Overwrite src/pages/ApplySuccess/ApplySuccess.jsx: useParams for applicationId. Show applicationId in large Typography. 'Copy shareable link' Button using navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href). Show MUI Snackbar 'Link copied!' on success. Link back to home. Render Navbar + Footer.

Step 8 — Overwrite src/pages/ViewApplication/ViewApplication.jsx: useParams for applicationId. Fetch getApplicationById(applicationId). Show Loader/error. Display: applicationId, name, email, phone, resumeLink (anchor), message, opportunity title + companyName. Render Navbar + Footer.
Step 10 — Overwrite src/pages/NotFound/NotFound.jsx: MUI Box centered, '404 - Page Not Found' Typography, Button 'Go Home' → navigate('/'). Render Navbar + Footer.
Step 11 — Overwrite src/pages/NotFound/NotFound.module.css: centered full-height layout.

Step 12 — Overwrite src/routes/AppRoutes.jsx: wire ALL 11 routes correctly. Public routes render Navbar+Footer inline in each page (already done above). Admin routes use nested structure: <Route element={<ProtectedRoute />}><Route element={<AdminLayout />}><Route path='/admin' element={<AdminOpportunities />} /><Route path='/admin/opportunities/new' element={<AdminOpportunityForm />} /><Route path='/admin/opportunities/:id/edit' element={<AdminOpportunityForm />} /><Route path='/admin/applications' element={<AdminApplications />} /></Route></Route>. Include /admin/login (no protection), /find-application, /applications/:applicationId (ViewApplication), /application-success/:applicationId (ApplySuccess). Import FindApplication from '../pages/FindApplication/index.jsx'.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with no errors after this FEAT
/ route renders Home page with search and filter controls
/application-success/:applicationId shows the applicationId and copy button
Admin routes redirect unauthenticated users to /admin/login
FindApplication page directory created at src/pages/FindApplication/
findings: All applicant pages implemented and build passes. Key notes for FEAT-003 (admin pages): admin stubs are still placeholders (AdminLogin, AdminOpportunities, AdminOpportunityForm, AdminApplications). AppRoutes.jsx is final — admin path '/admin' maps to AdminOpportunities (no separate /admin/opportunities path). AdminLayout sidebar navigates to '/admin/opportunities' which is NOT a registered route — FEAT-003 must either add that route or update AdminLayout to use '/admin' for Opportunities. ConfirmDialog is imported from '../components/common/ConfirmModal.jsx'. The icon CheckCircleOutlineIcon must be imported from '@mui/icons-material/CheckCircleOutlined' (not CheckCircleOutline). formatDate utility is at src/utils/formatDate.js.
